mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_tasks ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_user_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, name, mode, status, agent_external_id, agent_version, environment_external_id, dataset_external_id, dataset_version_external_id, rubric_external_id, rubric_version_external_id, pass_score, rubric_body, rubric_model, vault_ids, resources, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByUserUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Mode}, #{params.Status}, #{params.AgentExternalID}, #{params.AgentVersion}, #{params.EnvironmentExternalID}, #{params.DatasetExternalID}, #{params.DatasetVersionExternalID}, #{params.RubricExternalID}, #{params.RubricVersionExternalID}, #{params.PassScore}, #{params.RubricBody}, #{params.RubricModel}, CAST(#{params.VaultIDs} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Resources} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING

INSERT INTO evaluation_task_items ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, task_uuid, task_external_id, case_external_id, round, position, query, expected_answer, expected_tool_trace, acceptance, inputs, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.TaskUUID}, #{params.TaskExternalID}, #{params.CaseExternalID}, #{params.Round}, #{params.Position}, #{params.Query}, #{params.ExpectedAnswer}, CAST(#{params.ExpectedToolTrace} AS jsonb), #{params.Acceptance}, COALESCE(CAST(#{params.Inputs} AS jsonb), CAST('[]' AS jsonb)), 'pending', #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_tasks SET status = #{params.Status}, error_message = #{params.ErrorMessage}, updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt} WHERE organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND status = 'running' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_task_items i WHERE i.organization_uuid = evaluation_tasks.organization_uuid AND i.workspace_uuid = evaluation_tasks.workspace_uuid AND i.task_uuid = evaluation_tasks.uuid AND i.status IN ('pending', 'running') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_task_items i WHERE i.organization_uuid = evaluation_tasks.organization_uuid AND i.workspace_uuid = evaluation_tasks.workspace_uuid AND i.task_uuid = evaluation_tasks.uuid AND i.status = 'completed' AND i.round = ( SELECT MAX(r.round) FROM evaluation_task_items r WHERE r.organization_uuid = evaluation_tasks.organization_uuid AND r.workspace_uuid = evaluation_tasks.workspace_uuid AND r.task_uuid = evaluation_tasks.uuid ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_task_scores s WHERE s.organization_uuid = i.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = i.workspace_uuid AND s.item_uuid = i.uuid ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_task_scores ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, task_uuid, item_uuid, status, score, passed, explanation, answer, dimensions, error_message, judge_model, judge_prompt_version, judge_system, judge_prompt, judge_response, judge_input_tokens, judge_output_tokens, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.TaskUUID}, #{params.ItemUUID}, #{params.Status}, #{params.Score}, #{params.Passed}, #{params.Explanation}, #{params.Answer}, CAST(#{params.Dimensions} AS jsonb), #{params.ErrorMessage}, #{params.JudgeModel}, #{params.JudgePromptVersion}, #{params.JudgeSystem}, #{params.JudgePrompt}, #{params.JudgeResponse}, #{params.JudgeInputTokens}, #{params.JudgeOutputTokens}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT t.organization_uuid, t.workspace_uuid, t.external_id FROM evaluation_tasks t WHERE t.status = 'running' AND t.updated_at < #{updatedBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_task_items i WHERE i.organization_uuid = t.organization_uuid AND i.workspace_uuid = t.workspace_uuid AND i.task_uuid = t.uuid AND i.status IN ('pending', 'running') ) ORDER BY t.updated_at ASC, t.uuid ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM evaluation_task_items WHERE status = 'running' AND session_external_id <> '' AND updated_at < #{updatedBefore} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, uuid ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'output_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'output_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'cache_read_input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(COALESCE(e.payload->'model_usage', e.payload->'usage')->>'cache_read_input_tokens' AS bigint) END), 0) AS cache_read_input_tokens FROM session_events e WHERE e.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND e.event_type = 'span.model_request_end' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.session_external_id IN ( SELECT i.session_external_id FROM evaluation_task_items i WHERE i.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND i.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND i.task_uuid = #{taskUUID} AND i.session_external_id <> '' )
